surface_rules.description: All Go struct fields from the entity ID, subject, reference, pattern, prefix, scope, and gated-DAG fan-out set; every exact group requires a checked disposition
All Go declarations and calls whose function name is one of the five public entity-ID parser or validator APIs; every exact group requires a checked disposition
All JSON or YAML schema keys from the explicit contract field set, even without an example value; every exact group requires a checked disposition
Every Go function or method returning string whose body structurally concatenates or formats strings; every exact group requires a checked disposition
Every Go call to Get, Put, Delete, Watch, Keys, or ListKeysFiltered; every exact group requires a checked disposition
Every Go call to strings.Split; every exact group requires a checked disposition
Every Go call whose called function or method name contains match; every exact group requires a checked disposition
Entity-named Go string declarations containing regex metacharacters; inventoried but excluded from declaration-pattern values and every exact group requires a checked disposition
